name: TrustLayer Level 1 draft claim extraction fixtures
annotation_provenance: Agent-authored examples and annotations; independent human review has not occurred.
scope: Extraction boundaries, categories, and checkability only. Example claims are intentionally mixed in factual correctness and must not be treated as verified evidence.
annotation_policy: Gold spans preserve exact input substrings, exclude trailing sentence punctuation, and split independent predicates where possible. An elliptical claim retains its original subject in context rather than adding words to exact_text. Questions, requests, headings, and a bare URL are not claims. Subjective and predictive assertions may be claims but are not currently objectively checkable.

cases.response_text: OpenAI was founded in 2015, has no competitors, and generates $50 billion annually.
cases.notes: Blueprint example: three assertions with one shared subject. Extracting a claim never establishes whether it is true.

claims.exact_text: OpenAI was founded in 2015
has no competitors
generates $50 billion annually
